# @vllnt/convex-tickets

> Work items for Convex that humans and AI agents open, claim, discuss, hand off and resolve. One core, three thin layers: an agent board, a support desk and project tracking.

`@vllnt/convex-tickets` is a publishable Convex component. A ticket (a "work item") has a queue, a named state mapped to one of six fixed categories, a holder with a claim number (the fence), an optional lease, blockers, a thread, a history and a scheduled host hook. Claims are atomic: of two racing callers exactly one wins. Requires `convex@^1.45.0` and uses `@convex-dev/rate-limiter` for open and message rate limits. 0.1.0 is a canary release (the `canary` tag only).

For coding agents: this file, the API reference and the changelog are bundled in the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-tickets/`, next to the source in `src/`. They match the installed version. Read them before writing code against this package.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): What it is, installation, the refund example, the status model, guardrails, agent tools, the host hook and security
- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Package exports, `Tickets` methods, result unions, the `ticketEvent` payload, error codes and defaults
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-tickets/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, validation commands, and release workflow notes

## Source

- [Client](./src/client/index.ts): The `Tickets` class, `defineQueue` and the result types
- [Presets](./src/client/presets.ts): `agentQueue`, `deskQueue` and `projectQueue`
- [Agent tools](./src/client/tools.ts): `ticketTools`, the eight tools bound to one party
- [Shared](./src/shared.ts): Categories, transition types, `ERROR_CODES`, defaults and the `ticketEvent` payload

## Examples

These files are on GitHub `main` and may be newer than the installed version.

- [Example queues](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-tickets/blob/main/example/convex/tickets.ts): An agent queue, a human queue, a desk queue and a project queue on one mount
- [Example refund flow](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-tickets/blob/main/example/convex/example.ts): Open, claim, ask for input, hold on a blocker, hand off and resolve
- [Example hook](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-tickets/blob/main/example/convex/hooks.ts): A host hook that records events and wakes a scripted agent
- [Example tests](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-tickets/blob/main/example/convex/handoff_lifecycle.test.ts): End-to-end usage coverage with `convex-test`
